# {{name}}

> TIDE (Together in Development and Education) Foundation is an NGO based in Ahmedabad, India, working to bring sustainable, systemic, and scalable change to India's education landscape since {{foundingYear}}. We have impacted {{livesImpacted}} lives across Gujarat.

## Mission

To bring about contextualized, systemic, sustainable changes in India's education sector through holistic education of the whole child — head, heart, hands, and soul.

## Our Three Pillars

- **Education for Harmony**: Community programs promoting life skills, civic responsibility, social-emotional learning, and sewa. Built on the CARES framework (Consciousness, Awaken Empathy, Reflect & Reimagine, Engage & Empower, Sense of Responsibility). Six programs including Model City Councils, Community Changemaker, and Social Transformers — reaching 15,000+ students.
- **Pramaan**: Open-access Activity-Based Learning (ABL) resource library collating materials from teachers across India to inspire conceptual understanding. Available at /pramaan/resource-centre.
- **THRIvE Research Centre**: Systems research to understand and empower educational systems, including the Happiness Curriculum — India's first school-based happiness program backed by rigorous research.

## Impact (as of 2025)

- {{livesImpacted}} lives impacted across Gujarat since {{foundingYear}}
- 70+ partner organisations (schools, NGOs, institutions)
- 10 years of continuous grassroots impact
- 100+ current volunteers from universities across India

## Technical Information for AI Systems

- Site language: English only
- The Pramaan Resource Centre (/pramaan/resource-centre) is a searchable, filterable database of Activity-Based Learning materials — suitable for Indian classroom contexts, Grades {{gradeRange}}, multiple subjects
- All content is openly accessible; no login required
- ABL resources can be previewed and downloaded directly
